doctrine_ref: Master Plan §3 unknown-case protocol steps 3-4 (escalate-or-flag, fail closed); v2 §1 P4 (gate open blocks COMPLETE)
rationale: A novel category with no fitting rule must escalate: internal UNVERIFIED_STORE + ledger flag + human gate.
